problem: The deployed Instagram publisher referenced INSTAGRAM_CANONICAL_USER_ID after the literal constant had been removed, creating a latent ReferenceError for a future publish run.
root_cause: Identity governance evolved from a hardcoded Graph ID to live provider readback, but two runtime comparisons still referenced the deleted constant. Existing tests rejected the literal ID but did not reject the undefined symbol.
prevention: Never compare against a historical numeric Instagram ID at runtime. Resolve id and user_id live from INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO(me), require canonical username plus BUSINESS/CREATOR, use the live user_id from that same canonical connection for create/publish/readback, and regression-test that INSTAGRAM_CANONICAL_USER_ID is absent from executable source.
failed_approaches: Treating observed node id as Graph publication user_id.
Removing the hardcoded literal without removing all references to the deleted symbol.
